trust_decision.summary: Consensus decides, inline in each kapp payout loop during block execution, that a split-royalty payout may not exceed the royalty pool it is carved from and that each split percentage is at most HundredPercent (10000); the decision is taken by the tx processor with no out-of-band authority.

landing_point.why: The summary names split-royalty validation, and this is where a split map is first validated: percentages are summed into uint32 before being handed to kda.CheckValid100Params, so the sum silently wraps; the second attractor is the KLV payout in the market buy path (core/kapp/market/market.go:587-608).

fix_sites.entry_point: shared helper called from CreateAssetContract and AssetTriggerContract(UpdateRoyalties)
TransferContract (percentage royalties) - sender debit moved before the split distribution
BuyContract routed to the ITO kapp
BuyContract routed to the market kapp
config/node/enableEpochs.yaml activation epoch (gates every tx-processing path)
EpochConfirmed on the fork controller (gates every tx-processing path)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The ITO kapp is a separate feature (token offering) with its own royalty flow and its own split loop; the report talks about market-buy and transfer minting, so an engineer can argue the ITO payout path is a neighbouring feature rather than part of the fix.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A single split recipient at exactly 100% is legitimate: splitToPay == royaltiesToPay, the sender must still be debited exactly once and value must be conserved; an over-broad `>=` guard or a guard that also blocks equality breaks it, and pre-fork replay must keep the old wrapping behaviour (fork-gated).

O6_input_shapes: a percentage field above HundredPercent (10000), e.g. 0x80000000, in any of the six percent fields
two split entries whose uint32 sum wraps to 0, so kda.CheckValid100Params accepts it
a single split at exactly HundredPercent (equality must stay accepted)
sum of splits above 100% while each entry is at most 100% (60%+60%), rejected mid-loop
nil royalties / empty split map (must stay accepted)
percentage vs fixed royalty mode, and KLV vs KDA currency

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second split loop in processFixedRoyaltiesTransfer with its own fixed pool
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the maintainers already wrote one pool-accounting loop per royalty mode, so a fixed-royalty sibling with its own guard is natural

O8b_injection_room.sibling: ComputeITOFixedBuyRoyalties pays KLV splits from an amount already debited from the owner
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: it duplicates the market/accounts pool pattern in another package and is the closest legitimate neighbour to the 100%-split debit bug
the value is not derived from a percentage at all, so a guard copied from the percentage path would be wrong here

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a hardened CheckValid100Params that also rejects wrapped sums
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: both create and trigger callers hand it uint32 sums, so a maintainer could put the cap in the shared helper instead of the two handlers

O9_family: integer overflow (CWE-190) in percentage arithmetic leading to unbounded token minting
